senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) interpreter of the law, lawyer, lecturer.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:5">Koh. R. to VII, 5</cite>; a. fr.—Fem. <he>דַּרְשָׁנִית</he>, pl. <he>דַּרְשָׁנִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 119b">B. Bath. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ היו</he> (not <he>הן</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) were good lawyers (arguers).
